{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders only
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for refunded orders
print(f'Number of refunded orders: {df[df["status"] == "refunded"].shape[0]}')

# Check channel distribution
print(f'Channel distribution:
{completed_df["channel"].value_counts()}')

# Check customer_segment distribution by channel
print(f'Customer segment distribution by channel:
{completed_df.groupby("channel")["customer_segment"].value_counts()}')"}
